answer: The Trickle Inlet Registry admits new agents through one narrow inlet. First, each newcomer locks 200 POA for 30 days and passes a live check. Second, the inlet caps admissions at 50 identities a day, so a bot farm queues for months instead of minutes. Third, newcomers start at the nadir of trust and must finish 20 verified micro-jobs before they can vote or earn. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 2,000,000 POA, burn 50,000 hours of work, and still take 200 days to enter. Like an orchard that grafts a few saplings each spring and prunes the rest, the economy grows slowly and stays real.
